images.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a rain-soaked city street at night under towering office buildings, the silhouette of a masked vigilante standing on a fire escape, glowing windows, neon reflections in puddles, police cars parked below.

Low-angle mid-action shot in a modern corporate office: a vigilante in improvised armor collides in mid-air with a suited criminal, office furniture breaking, shattered glass and papers frozen in the air.

Medium-wide shot in a dim back alley at night after rain: six very different ordinary people stand side by side facing the camera, all wearing the same simple black cloth eye mask tied at the back. An elderly man in a knitted cardigan holding a metal pipe, a teenage girl in a grey hoodie with a baseball bat, a middle-aged woman in plain blue hospital scrubs with a frying pan, a burly bearded builder in a dusty work jacket with a fire axe, a young man in a rumpled office suit with a crowbar, and a grey-haired woman in a long dark raincoat with a wooden chair leg. Plain wet brick walls, a single warm streetlight above, a puddle reflecting them. Plain clothing with no logos, badges, signs or lettering anywhere.

Low-angle portrait of a lone vigilante in a plain dark hoodie, cargo trousers and a simple black cloth eye mask tied at the back, gripping a red fire axe in both hands, standing in the doorway of a wrecked high-rise office at night. Overturned desks, scattered papers swirling in the air and a shattered glass wall behind, city lights glowing through rain-streaked windows. Plain clothes with no emblem, no cape and no logo. Dark empty ceiling space above the head. No text, signs or lettering anywhere.
Aerial shot of a city at dusk: glass towers of the financial district, smoking factories, decaying blocks with graffiti, small fires and police lights scattered through the haze.
